article.story: CLEVELAND -- — Rayvon Griffith scored 34 points as Cleveland State beat Michigan-Dearborn 103-79 on Friday. Griffith added five rebounds for the Vikings (1-1). Micah Bays scored 18 points while going 5 of 10 from the floor, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and 6 for 8 from the line, and added five assists. Jordan Lowery had 15 points and shot 5 of 7 from the field and 5 for 5 from the line. Nick Sobush led the way for the Wolverines with 22 points and three steals. Jackson Reynolds added 21 points for Michigan-Dearborn. Terrance Hicks finished with 20 points. Up next Cleveland State takes on Bowling Green on the road on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
